  # classic green zone (ratchet history 356 → 65 → 16 → 8 → 12 → 8). Only
  # down from here.
  threshold: 8.0
  # _listModels used to hit 20 with 0% coverage (line-mode-only output);
  # covered by test/cli/provider_models_line_mode_test.dart in #1234.

# ─── loc gate (issue #1234, gh-1232 migration) ─────────────────────────────
# The ≤2800-line file guard MOVED from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size +
# the ci.yml shell find-exec guards onto crap4dart's `loc` gate (0.11.0,
# maintainer-confirmed wc -l semantics). Enforced whole-tree on every merge
# validation via `crap4dart check --baseline` (CI quality-gates step) and
# staged files in the pre-commit hook — no staged-scoping escape, no
# hook-dependence, merge-bot merges included. max_lines only DOWN;
# app_localizations.dart is gen-l10n OUTPUT (no .g.dart suffix) — excluded,
# not baselined.

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right
  # before the CRAP step runs.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is
# enforced here, everything else is disabled explicitly so a bare
# `check --staged` (pre-commit, core-only #433 split) means exactly the
# pixel gate. The flutter_app goldens live in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: the whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was stage_size +
  # ci.yml shell find-exec, gh-1232). wc -l semantics, generated output
  # excluded — nothing exceeds 2800 today, so the shrink-only baseline
  # starts EMPTY of loc entries.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
      - 'vendor/**'
  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet above already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}
  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
  unused_code: {enabled: false}
  unused_files: {enabled: false} # follow-up card (issue #1234 §5). Known
    # FPs to exclude when enabling: the conditional-export IO entry points
    # (lib/io.dart, lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart — public barrels whose
    # importers live outside this repo's import graph) and shared pinned
    # data modules imported only from test/ (lib/src/cli/omp_reg_scenarios.dart,
    # issue #810). lib/fanet.dart was the one confirmed-dead hit — deleted
    # in #1234.
  banned_imports: {enabled: false}
  # Type-2 duplication gate (issue #1106, crap4dart 0.11.0). Renamed-clone
  # detection on top of the Type-1 default; the union with the raw pass can
  # only ADD findings, never lose exact copies. severity: warning starts
  # soft — escalate to error once the 13-file triage debt is paid
  # (follow-up, owner-side). The global jscpd <1% guards stay as-is.
  #
  # Two suppression channels with different contracts:
  # - `// crap:ignore` (needs ignorable: true) = a JUSTIFIED structural
  #   twin, suppressed forever, with a one-line reason in the comment.
  # - `.crap-baseline.json` (via `check --baseline`) = LEGACY debt; the
  #   committed snapshot must only SHRINK: after each triage batch re-run
  #   `dart pub global run crap4dart check --save-baseline` and commit the
  #   only-down diff, or the snapshot rots and starts masking shifts.
  #
  # WINDOW (until severity flips to error): the gate never fails a build —
  # new (not-baselined) duplication only surfaces as a `[WARN]` line in
  # `check` output. Enforcement becomes hard exactly when the owner-side
  # escalation lands; from then on any finding outside the two channels
  # fails CI/pre-commit.
  duplication:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    ignorable: true # enables `// crap:ignore` for justified structural twins
    ignore_locals: true # Type-2: rename locals before hashing (API names stay)
    ignore_literals: false # keeps l10n/theme/symbol tables out
    sources: # cross-module scope from #487
      - flutter_app/lib
      - packages/fa_ui/lib
      - packages/fa_llm/lib
  file_naming: {enabled: false}
  magic_constants: {enabled: false}
  test_assertions: {enabled: false}
  folder_structure: {enabled: false}
  external: {enabled: false}
  public_docs: {enabled: false}
  golden: {enabled: false} # flutter-only gate (core is not a Flutter project)
  accessibility: {enabled: false}
  hardcoded_strings: {enabled: false}

  # Pixel gate over core test/ goldens — none exist today, so this is a
  # no-op that guards the future (issue #447 AC: "and core test/ goldens
  # if any appear"). WARNING, same rationale as flutter_app: the 0.9.5
  # detector misses the Ahem-solid-rect and hollow-square classes and
  # false-positives on V-converging shapes; flip to error when the
  # upstream detector fixes land.
  broken_goldens:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    dirs: [test]
    exclude:
      # TUI screenshots, not goldens: amber/yellow text on the dark theme
      # trips the stripe heuristic (measured 14/14 "overflow stripes" —
      # the same yellow-on-dark detector bug the issue documents for
      # apps_panel/panel_dark). Revisit when upstream fixes land.
      - 'test/integration/**'

stage_size() {
  # Hook mode scopes the guard to the STAGED Dart files: the guard ratchets
  # what a commit touches, so a pre-existing oversized file elsewhere (e.g.
  # flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart, which ci.yml's guard never
  # measures — it scans lib/test/example only) cannot block an unrelated
  # commit. Non-hook runs keep the whole-tree scan below.
  if [ "$HOOK_MODE" -eq 1 ]; then
    local violations
    violations=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM \
      | grep '\.dart$' \
      | grep -vE '\.g\.dart$|\.freezed\.dart$|\.mocks\.dart$|bridge_generated|app_localizations|localizations_' \
      | while IFS= read -r f; do
          [ -f "$f" ] || continue
          lines=$(wc -l < "$f")
          if [ "$lines" -gt "$MAX_LINES" ]; then echo "$f: $lines lines"; fi
        done || true)
    if [ -n "$violations" ]; then
      echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — FILE SIZE (max $MAX_LINES lines)" >&2
      echo "$violations" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    return 0
  fi
  # Same find-exec guard as ci.yml / pre-commit: no dart file over MAX_LINES.
  local dirs=""
  local d
  for d in lib test example bin; do
    [ -d "$d" ] && dirs="$dirs $d"
  done
  if [ "$APP_IN_SCOPE" -eq 1 ] && [ -d flutter_app/lib ]; then
    dirs="$dirs flutter_app/lib"
  fi
  local violations
  violations=$(find $dirs -name '*.dart' \
    ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
    ! -name '*bridge_generated*.dart' ! -name '*app_localizations*.dart' \
    ! -name '*localizations_*.dart' \
    -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt '"$MAX_LINES"' ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
  if [ -n "$violations" ]; then
    echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — FILE SIZE (max $MAX_LINES lines)" >&2
    echo "$violations" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

  nesting: {enabled: false}

    # FPs to exclude when enabling: the conditional-export IO entry points

    # importers live outside this repo's import graph) and shared pinned
    # data modules imported only from test/ (lib/src/cli/omp_reg_scenarios.dart,

  # Type-2 duplication gate (issue #1106, crap4dart 0.11.0). Renamed-clone

  #

    ignorable: true # enables `// crap:ignore` for justified structural twins

  file_naming: {enabled: false}
  magic_constants: {enabled: false}
  test_assertions: {enabled: false}
  folder_structure: {enabled: false}

stage_size() {
  # Hook mode scopes the guard to the STAGED Dart files: the guard ratchets
  # what a commit touches, so a pre-existing oversized file elsewhere (e.g.
  # flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart, which ci.yml's guard never
  # measures — it scans lib/test/example only) cannot block an unrelated
  # commit. Non-hook runs keep the whole-tree scan below.
  if [ "$HOOK_MODE" -eq 1 ]; then
    local violations
    violations=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM \
      | grep '\.dart$' \
      | grep -vE '\.g\.dart$|\.freezed\.dart$|\.mocks\.dart$|bridge_generated|app_localizations|localizations_' \
      | while IFS= read -r f; do
          [ -f "$f" ] || continue
          lines=$(wc -l < "$f")
          if [ "$lines" -gt "$MAX_LINES" ]; then echo "$f: $lines lines"; fi
        done || true)
    if [ -n "$violations" ]; then
      echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — FILE SIZE (max $MAX_LINES lines)" >&2
      echo "$violations" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    return 0
  fi
  # Same find-exec guard as ci.yml / pre-commit: no dart file over MAX_LINES.
  local dirs=""
  local d
  for d in lib test example bin; do
    [ -d "$d" ] && dirs="$dirs $d"
  done
  if [ "$APP_IN_SCOPE" -eq 1 ] && [ -d flutter_app/lib ]; then
    dirs="$dirs flutter_app/lib"
  fi
  local violations
  violations=$(find $dirs -name '*.dart' \
    ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
    ! -name '*bridge_generated*.dart' ! -name '*app_localizations*.dart' \
    ! -name '*localizations_*.dart' \
    -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt '"$MAX_LINES"' ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
  if [ -n "$violations" ]; then
    echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — FILE SIZE (max $MAX_LINES lines)" >&2
    echo "$violations" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

- CC-12 trio split into cohesive sub-dispatchers: `_treeMoveKey`/`_treeCollapseKey` (agent_hub_tui.dart), `_scanAgentRoot`/`_ingestAgentEntry` (task/agent_discovery.dart), `_rewriteAssistantCallIds`/`_emitSlotResults` (agent/tool_pairing.dart)

**AC5 — unused_files triage**: `lib/fanet.dart` deleted — zero references anywhere (not in the main barrel, no imports, no docs/scripts). `omp_reg_scenarios.dart` kept — NOT dead: live test importer (test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart) and the #810 pinned-shared-data docstring says it must stay. The conditional-export IO FP class (lib/io.dart style entry points) is documented with exclude guidance at the `unused_files` config line for the follow-up card. Gate enabling stays a follow-up per the issue's §5 adoption order ("this card = loc + whole-tree CRAP + §3 fixes").

## Verification (honest disclosure)

- `scripts/check_crap_guards.py` — green locally: badge==config parity (8.0/30.0), generated-exclude parity, `--only-down origin/main` pass.
- YAML validity of both configs + ci.yml asserted; `bash -n` on the touched shell scripts.
- **The dart toolchain on this box is SIGKILLed by the machine guard (exit 137 on `dart --version`)** — the targeted `dart analyze` + new test files could NOT be run locally. CI is the real gate: the static job compiles/analyzes, test shards run the 3 new/extended suites, and the quality-gates step measures whole-tree CRAP against 8.0. If the whole-tree check finds a method over 8.0 that emerged from post-census merges, I'll fix it in this PR.
- New/changed tests were cross-checked statically against the exact helper scaffolds and output strings they assert (`models (provider/model):`, `use /model <n> or`, `no models available` at provider_models.dart:831-834; `_replaceWindowWithChunk` below-count semantics; `parseFrontmatter` trim/newline behavior).

## Threshold-movement ledger (ratchet law)

- core CRAP: 12.0 → 8.0 because the 16 flagged methods above moved (splits + coverage). Only down.
- loc.max_lines: introduced at 2800 (the gh-1232 ceiling, unchanged); baseline entries: none.
- flutter_app CRAP: untouched at 30.0 (not this card's ladder).

## Remaining (none blocking)

- CI green-light on the 8.0 repin (the only unverifiable-locally item, per the disclosure above).
- Follow-up cards per §5 adoption order: `unused_files` gate enabling (excludes documented in-config), `banned_imports` rules, complexity quartet baseline, `public_docs`.

  # flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart, which ci.yml's guard never
  # measures — it scans lib/test/example only) cannot block an unrelated
  # commit. Non-hook runs keep the whole-tree scan below.
  if [ "$HOOK_MODE" -eq 1 ]; then
    local violations
    violations=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM \
      | grep '\.dart$' \
      | grep -vE '\.g\.dart$|\.freezed\.dart$|\.mocks\.dart$|bridge_generated|app_localizations|localizations_' \
      | while IFS= read -r f; do
          [ -f "$f" ] || continue
          lines=$(wc -l < "$f")
          if [ "$lines" -gt "$MAX_LINES" ]; then echo "$f: $lines lines"; fi
        done || true)
    if [ -n "$violations" ]; then
      echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — FILE SIZE (max $MAX_LINES lines)" >&2
      echo "$violations" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    return 0
  fi
  # Same find-exec guard as ci.yml / pre-commit: no dart file over MAX_LINES.
  local dirs=""
  local d
  for d in lib test example bin; do
    [ -d "$d" ] && dirs="$dirs $d"

# crap4dart configuration for flutter_agent_harness.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart
#
# RATCHET: the CRAP threshold is pinned at the current worst score
# (356.34, `_handleKey` in bin/../tui_repl.dart) — pushes may only make
# the codebase BETTER, never worse. Lower the threshold whenever the top
# offenders are fixed (run: dart pub global run crap4dart analyze).

sources: [lib, bin]

exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'
  - 'vendor/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in the repo. Descent (issue #1234): the
  # whole-tree offenders went down — readPasteboardImage 16.32 (split into
  # fake-seam / platform-dispatch helpers), the CC-12 trio (_handleTreeKey,
  # discoverTaskAgents, _rebuild) split into cohesive sub-dispatchers, the
  # four 0%-cov CC-3 methods covered by tests (frontmatter, video endpoint,
  # below-window ingest, provider picker), the CC-9 tier split or covered,
  # and _listModels covered by the line-mode /models test (the old NOTE
  # below is history). Threshold follows the fixes: 12.0 → 8.0 — the
  # classic green zone (ratchet history 356 → 65 → 16 → 8 → 12 → 8). Only
  # down from here.
  threshold: 8.0
  # _listModels used to hit 20 with 0% coverage (line-mode-only output);
  # covered by test/cli/provider_models_line_mode_test.dart in #1234.

# ─── loc gate (issue #1234, gh-1232 migration) ─────────────────────────────
# The ≤2800-line file guard MOVED from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size +
# the ci.yml shell find-exec guards onto crap4dart's `loc` gate (0.11.0,
# maintainer-confirmed wc -l semantics). Enforced whole-tree on every merge
# validation via `crap4dart check --baseline` (CI quality-gates step) and
# staged files in the pre-commit hook — no staged-scoping escape, no
# hook-dependence, merge-bot merges included. max_lines only DOWN;
# app_localizations.dart is gen-l10n OUTPUT (no .g.dart suffix) — excluded,
# not baselined.

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right
  # before the CRAP step runs.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.

stage_size() {
  # Hook mode scopes the guard to the STAGED Dart files: the guard ratchets
  # what a commit touches, so a pre-existing oversized file elsewhere (e.g.
  # flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart, which ci.yml's guard never
  # measures — it scans lib/test/example only) cannot block an unrelated
  # commit. Non-hook runs keep the whole-tree scan below.
  if [ "$HOOK_MODE" -eq 1 ]; then
    local violations
    violations=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM \
      | grep '\.dart$' \
      | grep -vE '\.g\.dart$|\.freezed\.dart$|\.mocks\.dart$|bridge_generated|app_localizations|localizations_' \
      | while IFS= read -r f; do
          [ -f "$f" ] || continue
          lines=$(wc -l < "$f")
          if [ "$lines" -gt "$MAX_LINES" ]; then echo "$f: $lines lines"; fi
        done || true)
    if [ -n "$violations" ]; then
      echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — FILE SIZE (max $MAX_LINES lines)" >&2
      echo "$violations" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    return 0
  fi
  # Same find-exec guard as ci.yml / pre-commit: no dart file over MAX_LINES.
  local dirs=""
  local d
  for d in lib test example bin; do
    [ -d "$d" ] && dirs="$dirs $d"
  done
  if [ "$APP_IN_SCOPE" -eq 1 ] && [ -d flutter_app/lib ]; then
    dirs="$dirs flutter_app/lib"
  fi
  local violations
  violations=$(find $dirs -name '*.dart' \
    ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
    ! -name '*bridge_generated*.dart' ! -name '*app_localizations*.dart' \
    ! -name '*localizations_*.dart' \
    -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt '"$MAX_LINES"' ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
  if [ -n "$violations" ]; then
    echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — FILE SIZE (max $MAX_LINES lines)" >&2
    echo "$violations" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1291
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1291
- **Title**: fix(1234): whole-tree CRAP ratchet 12→8, loc-gate migration, all top offenders fixed
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1234-crap-ratchet-max` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 26
- **Additions**: +810
- **Deletions**: -373
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T12:56:12Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T14:08:19Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1234

## Delivered (AC by AC)

**AC1 — §3 table empty, threshold repinned 12.0 → 8.0** (`crap4dart.yaml`). Threshold moved because the code moved — every census method fixed in this PR:

- `readPasteboardImage` 16.32 → split: `_readFakePasteboard` / `_effectivePlatform` / `_readPlatform` (cli/clipboard_reader.dart)
- CC-12 trio split into cohesive sub-dispatchers: `_treeMoveKey`/`_treeCollapseKey` (agent_hub_tui.dart), `_scanAgentRoot`/`_ingestAgentEntry` (task/agent_discovery.dart), `_rewriteAssistantCallIds`/`_emitSlotResults` (agent/tool_pairing.dart)
- CC-9 tier split: `_kimiImplicitKeyPath`, `_readPassphraseStdin`/`_readPassphrasePrompt`, `_readTtsrSource`/`_validateTtsrEdit`, `_dialInlineImage`/`_dialDownloadUrl`, `_decodeManifestJson`, `_readToolIsSqlite`, `_runVideoGeneration`/`_videoEndpointOrThrow`, `parseStatusLineConfig` helpers
- 0%-cov CC-3 quartet covered by new tests: `parseFrontmatter` (test/utils/frontmatter_parser_test.dart), `resolveVideoGenerationEndpoint` (test/tools/generate_video_test.dart group), `WindowedSessionStorage._ingestBelowWindow` (deep-paged ingest test), `AgentCli._tuiPickProvider` (picker routing test)
- `_listModels` (CRAP 20 @ 0%): covered by test/cli/provider_models_line_mode_test.dart — the line-mode `/models` output path (header/numbered rows/switch hint, unknown-filter branch), via a new `tuiPickProviderForTest` seam alongside the existing ForTest convention. The old "do not ratchet up for it" NOTE is resolved, not exempted.

**AC2 — loc gate + baseline in CI**: `loc: {enabled: true, max_lines: 2800}` in BOTH crap4dart.yaml files (maintainer recipe from the issue comments). Generated excludes per recipe; `flutter_app/lib/l10n/app_localizations.dart` (gen-l10n output, no `.g.dart` suffix) is gate-excluded, not baselined — per the issue's disposition column. **All four census files sit under 2800 on this branch** (gh-1232 splits landed: fah.dart 225, agent_service.dart 2399, wasm_shell.dart 2740), so the committed `.crap-baseline.json` needs ZERO loc entries — shrink-only baseline intact, nothing to pin. Enforcement: `crap4dart check --baseline` (already wired by gh-1232) now runs the loc gate whole-tree on every merge validation, core and app pipelines both.

**AC3 — whole-tree CRAP in CI**: the same `crap4dart check --baseline` steps run the crap gate against the pinned 8.0 on every merge validation (not staged-scoped, merge-bot included). A method pushed over threshold in an untouched file goes red here — that was the latent-red escape the issue documents.

**AC4 — shell guards removed**: `stage_size` + `MAX_LINES` deleted from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh (stage lists, scope maps, runner case, banner); both ci.yml find-exec guards deleted with migration notes. GOAL.md quality-gates section now names the real enforcement points (crap4dart loc + whole-tree CRAP in CI). AGENTS.md CRAP section updated (core 8.0, app 30.0 as measured, 0.11 pin); README badge → 8.0; pre-commit banner updated.

**AC5 — unused_files triage**: `lib/fanet.dart` deleted — zero references anywhere (not in the main barrel, no imports, no docs/scripts). `omp_reg_scenarios.dart` kept — NOT dead: live test importer (test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart) and the #810 pinned-shared-data docstring says it must stay. The conditional-export IO FP class (lib/io.dart style entry points) is documented with exclude guidance at the `unused_files` config line for the follow-up card. Gate enabling stays a follow-up per the issue's §5 adoption order ("this card = loc + whole-tree CRAP + §3 fixes").

## Verification (honest disclosure)

- `scripts/check_crap_guards.py` — green locally: badge==config parity (8.0/30.0), generated-exclude parity, `--only-down origin/main` pass.
- YAML validity of both configs + ci.yml asserted; `bash -n` on the touched shell scripts.
- **The dart toolchain on this box is SIGKILLed by the machine guard (exit 137 on `dart --version`)** — the targeted `dart analyze` + new test files could NOT be run locally. CI is the real gate: the static job compiles/analyzes, test shards run the 3 new/extended suites, and the quality-gates step measures whole-tree CRAP against 8.0. If the whole-tree check finds a method over 8.0 that emerged from post-census merges, I'll fix it in this PR.
- New/changed tests were cross-checked statically against the exact helper scaffolds and output strings they assert (`models (provider/model):`, `use /model <n> or`, `no models available` at provider_models.dart:831-834; `_replaceWindowWithChunk` below-count semantics; `parseFrontmatter` trim/newline behavior).

## Threshold-movement ledger (ratchet law)

- core CRAP: 12.0 → 8.0 because the 16 flagged methods above moved (splits + coverage). Only down.
- loc.max_lines: introduced at 2800 (the gh-1232 ceiling, unchanged); baseline entries: none.
- flutter_app CRAP: untouched at 30.0 (not this card's ladder).

## Remaining (none blocking)

- CI green-light on the 8.0 repin (the only unverifiable-locally item, per the disclosure above).
- Follow-up cards per §5 adoption order: `unused_files` gate enabling (excludes documented in-config), `banned_imports` rules, complexity quartet baseline, `public_docs`.

### Thread 1

**vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit** (2026-10-05):
Root cause of the add-in-suite InvalidType at generate_video.dart:641: the `_runVideoGeneration` ratchet extraction named `CancelToken?` explicitly while the original inline closure had the parameter inferred from the `execute` typedef — the file never imported `../cancel_token.dart`. Added the import (babfc7a7→this head); swept every other lib/ file in the diff for the same class of bug: all named types in added signatures were already imported in their files (verbatim code moves). Still no local dart (exit 137) — PR CI remains the gate.

---

### Thread 2

**vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit** (2026-10-05):
Root cause of ext_install.dart:375: the `_parseManifest` ratchet split left `_decodeManifestJson` at return type `Object?` although the helper throws on anything but `Map<String, dynamic>` — `ExtensionManifest.fromJson` then received an unnarrowed argument (masked before only by the CancelToken cascade). Fixed at the helper's return type (the precise root, no cast at the callsite); swept the rest of the diff — it was the only callsite and the only Object?-returning helper introduced. CI remains the gate.

---

### Thread 3

**vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit** (2026-10-05):
FLAKE, not a regression — dap_cli_e2e_test.dart:98 ('Expected: String, Actual: null'): line 98 is `expect(config['clientSecret'], isA<String>())`, the persisted-credential read; the preceding hub bind failures in job 111787892837 ('cannot bind 127.0.0.1:34743 / :34043 — something else holds the port', 13:34:47/50) are the intra-shard port race leaving the hub unserved/enroll unpersisted, so the config read lands null. Diff inventory (origin/main...HEAD, 26 files) touches NOTHING in the dap/hub/credential path: no dap_cli_e2e_test.dart, no bin/fah_dap_command.dart, no hub sources, no secrets/credential persistence, nothing under test/integration/ — the lane's files are CI workflow, ratchet configs/docs, 12 CLI/tool lib files (provider pickers, media tools, TTSR, message rebuild) and 4 non-integration test files. Zero fixes pushed; SM re-run is the arbiter. Signature 'dap-cli-e2e :98 clientSecret null after bind-fail' = 1st hit for the freeze ledger.

---

### Thread 4

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-05):
⚠️ Validation CI went red on the head. Guest PR: the rework agent is armed on this PR (owner directive 2026-10-04) — it fixes the findings and pushes; your own push re-runs validation just the same.
🔴 red head 3249366dc896a8125564963e591aee34204211f6 — red 1/3 (owner directive 2026-10-04: red yields the slot — after 3 reds on the same head, validation waits for a NEW head)
🔁 guest rework arm 1/2 (owner directive 2026-10-04)

---

### Thread 5

**vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit** (2026-10-05):
Root cause of the windowed_session_storage_test.dart:498 failure: NOT a timing race — a deterministic setup bug in my new test. The deep-paged ingest test jumped with the default chunk cap (`defaultChunkRecords` = 200), so `readAround` swallowed the whole 10-record fixture into the window; the window bottom reached the file tail, and `ingestAppended` correctly took the TAIL path (`_ingestAtTail` → delta [e10]) instead of the below-window path the test names. Both jumps now pass `maxRecords: 5` so the jump chunk cannot reach the tail: the below-window state is real, and the assertions pin the actual contract (no delta, no re-anchor, offsets remembered for jumps). No production change; MemoryExecutionEnv makes it fully deterministic. (Push also integrates the SM's two main-stackings on the branch — clean merge, lane changes intact.)

---

# The ≤2800-line file guard MOVED from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size +

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right

  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is
# enforced here, everything else is disabled explicitly so a bare
# `check --staged` (pre-commit, core-only #433 split) means exactly the
# pixel gate. The flutter_app goldens live in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: the whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was stage_size +
  # ci.yml shell find-exec, gh-1232). wc -l semantics, generated output
  # excluded — nothing exceeds 2800 today, so the shrink-only baseline
  # starts EMPTY of loc entries.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
      - 'vendor/**'
  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet above already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}
  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
  unused_code: {enabled: false}
  unused_files: {enabled: false} # follow-up card (issue #1234 §5). Known
    # FPs to exclude when enabling: the conditional-export IO entry points
    # (lib/io.dart, lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart — public barrels whose
    # importers live outside this repo's import graph) and shared pinned
    # data modules imported only from test/ (lib/src/cli/omp_reg_scenarios.dart,
    # issue #810). lib/fanet.dart was the one confirmed-dead hit — deleted
    # in #1234.
  banned_imports: {enabled: false}
  # Type-2 duplication gate (issue #1106, crap4dart 0.11.0). Renamed-clone
  # detection on top of the Type-1 default; the union with the raw pass can
  # only ADD findings, never lose exact copies. severity: warning starts
  # soft — escalate to error once the 13-file triage debt is paid
  # (follow-up, owner-side). The global jscpd <1% guards stay as-is.
  #
  # Two suppression channels with different contracts:
  # - `// crap:ignore` (needs ignorable: true) = a JUSTIFIED structural
  #   twin, suppressed forever, with a one-line reason in the comment.
  # - `.crap-baseline.json` (via `check --baseline`) = LEGACY debt; the
  #   committed snapshot must only SHRINK: after each triage batch re-run
  #   `dart pub global run crap4dart check --save-baseline` and commit the
  #   only-down diff, or the snapshot rots and starts masking shifts.
  #
  # WINDOW (until severity flips to error): the gate never fails a build —
  # new (not-baselined) duplication only surfaces as a `[WARN]` line in
  # `check` output. Enforcement becomes hard exactly when the owner-side
  # escalation lands; from then on any finding outside the two channels
  # fails CI/pre-commit.
  duplication:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    ignorable: true # enables `// crap:ignore` for justified structural twins
    ignore_locals: true # Type-2: rename locals before hashing (API names stay)
    ignore_literals: false # keeps l10n/theme/symbol tables out
    sources: # cross-module scope from #487
      - flutter_app/lib
      - packages/fa_ui/lib
      - packages/fa_llm/lib
  file_naming: {enabled: false}
  magic_constants: {enabled: false}
  test_assertions: {enabled: false}
  folder_structure: {enabled: false}
  external: {enabled: false}
  public_docs: {enabled: false}
  golden: {enabled: false} # flutter-only gate (core is not a Flutter project)
  accessibility: {enabled: false}
  hardcoded_strings: {enabled: false}

  # Pixel gate over core test/ goldens — none exist today, so this is a
  # no-op that guards the future (issue #447 AC: "and core test/ goldens
  # if any appear"). WARNING, same rationale as flutter_app: the 0.9.5
  # detector misses the Ahem-solid-rect and hollow-square classes and
  # false-positives on V-converging shapes; flip to error when the
  # upstream detector fixes land.
  broken_goldens:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    dirs: [test]
    exclude:

      # trips the stripe heuristic (measured 14/14 "overflow stripes" —
      # the same yellow-on-dark detector bug the issue documents for
      # apps_panel/panel_dark). Revisit when upstream fixes land.
      - 'test/integration/**'

stage_size() {
  # Hook mode scopes the guard to the STAGED Dart files: the guard ratchets
  # what a commit touches, so a pre-existing oversized file elsewhere (e.g.
  # flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart, which ci.yml's guard never
  # measures — it scans lib/test/example only) cannot block an unrelated
  # commit. Non-hook runs keep the whole-tree scan below.
  if [ "$HOOK_MODE" -eq 1 ]; then
    local violations
    violations=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM \
      | grep '\.dart$' \
      | grep -vE '\.g\.dart$|\.freezed\.dart$|\.mocks\.dart$|bridge_generated|app_localizations|localizations_' \
      | while IFS= read -r f; do
          [ -f "$f" ] || continue
          lines=$(wc -l < "$f")
          if [ "$lines" -gt "$MAX_LINES" ]; then echo "$f: $lines lines"; fi
        done || true)
    if [ -n "$violations" ]; then
      echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — FILE SIZE (max $MAX_LINES lines)" >&2
      echo "$violations" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    return 0
  fi
  # Same find-exec guard as ci.yml / pre-commit: no dart file over MAX_LINES.
  local dirs=""
  local d
  for d in lib test example bin; do
    [ -d "$d" ] && dirs="$dirs $d"
  done
  if [ "$APP_IN_SCOPE" -eq 1 ] && [ -d flutter_app/lib ]; then
    dirs="$dirs flutter_app/lib"
  fi
  local violations
  violations=$(find $dirs -name '*.dart' \
    ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
    ! -name '*bridge_generated*.dart' ! -name '*app_localizations*.dart' \
    ! -name '*localizations_*.dart' \
    -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt '"$MAX_LINES"' ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
  if [ -n "$violations" ]; then
    echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — FILE SIZE (max $MAX_LINES lines)" >&2
    echo "$violations" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

sources: [lib, bin]

exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'
  - 'vendor/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in the repo. Descent (issue #1234): the
  # whole-tree offenders went down — readPasteboardImage 16.32 (split into
  # fake-seam / platform-dispatch helpers), the CC-12 trio (_handleTreeKey,
  # discoverTaskAgents, _rebuild) split into cohesive sub-dispatchers, the
  # four 0%-cov CC-3 methods covered by tests (frontmatter, video endpoint,
  # below-window ingest, provider picker), the CC-9 tier split or covered,
  # and _listModels covered by the line-mode /models test (the old NOTE
  # below is history). Threshold follows the fixes: 12.0 → 8.0 — the
  # classic green zone (ratchet history 356 → 65 → 16 → 8 → 12 → 8). Only
  # down from here.
  threshold: 8.0
  # _listModels used to hit 20 with 0% coverage (line-mode-only output);
  # covered by test/cli/provider_models_line_mode_test.dart in #1234.

# ─── loc gate (issue #1234, gh-1232 migration) ─────────────────────────────
# The ≤2800-line file guard MOVED from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size +
# the ci.yml shell find-exec guards onto crap4dart's `loc` gate (0.11.0,
# maintainer-confirmed wc -l semantics). Enforced whole-tree on every merge

# hook-dependence, merge-bot merges included. max_lines only DOWN;
# app_localizations.dart is gen-l10n OUTPUT (no .g.dart suffix) — excluded,
# not baselined.

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right
  # before the CRAP step runs.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

stage_size() {
  # Hook mode scopes the guard to the STAGED Dart files: the guard ratchets
  # what a commit touches, so a pre-existing oversized file elsewhere (e.g.
  # flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart, which ci.yml's guard never
  # measures — it scans lib/test/example only) cannot block an unrelated
  # commit. Non-hook runs keep the whole-tree scan below.
  if [ "$HOOK_MODE" -eq 1 ]; then
    local violations
    violations=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM \
      | grep '\.dart$' \
      | grep -vE '\.g\.dart$|\.freezed\.dart$|\.mocks\.dart$|bridge_generated|app_localizations|localizations_' \
      | while IFS= read -r f; do
          [ -f "$f" ] || continue
          lines=$(wc -l < "$f")
          if [ "$lines" -gt "$MAX_LINES" ]; then echo "$f: $lines lines"; fi
        done || true)
    if [ -n "$violations" ]; then
      echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — FILE SIZE (max $MAX_LINES lines)" >&2
      echo "$violations" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    return 0
  fi
  # Same find-exec guard as ci.yml / pre-commit: no dart file over MAX_LINES.
  local dirs=""
  local d
  for d in lib test example bin; do
    [ -d "$d" ] && dirs="$dirs $d"
  done
  if [ "$APP_IN_SCOPE" -eq 1 ] && [ -d flutter_app/lib ]; then
    dirs="$dirs flutter_app/lib"
  fi
  local violations
  violations=$(find $dirs -name '*.dart' \
    ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
    ! -name '*bridge_generated*.dart' ! -name '*app_localizations*.dart' \
    ! -name '*localizations_*.dart' \
    -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt '"$MAX_LINES"' ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
  if [ -n "$violations" ]; then
    echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — FILE SIZE (max $MAX_LINES lines)" >&2
    echo "$violations" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

- CC-12 trio split into cohesive sub-dispatchers: `_treeMoveKey`/`_treeCollapseKey` (agent_hub_tui.dart), `_scanAgentRoot`/`_ingestAgentEntry` (task/agent_discovery.dart), `_rewriteAssistantCallIds`/`_emitSlotResults` (agent/tool_pairing.dart)

**AC5 — unused_files triage**: `lib/fanet.dart` deleted — zero references anywhere (not in the main barrel, no imports, no docs/scripts). `omp_reg_scenarios.dart` kept — NOT dead: live test importer (test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart) and the #810 pinned-shared-data docstring says it must stay. The conditional-export IO FP class (lib/io.dart style entry points) is documented with exclude guidance at the `unused_files` config line for the follow-up card. Gate enabling stays a follow-up per the issue's §5 adoption order ("this card = loc + whole-tree CRAP + §3 fixes").

## Verification (honest disclosure)

- `scripts/check_crap_guards.py` — green locally: badge==config parity (8.0/30.0), generated-exclude parity, `--only-down origin/main` pass.
- YAML validity of both configs + ci.yml asserted; `bash -n` on the touched shell scripts.
- **The dart toolchain on this box is SIGKILLed by the machine guard (exit 137 on `dart --version`)** — the targeted `dart analyze` + new test files could NOT be run locally. CI is the real gate: the static job compiles/analyzes, test shards run the 3 new/extended suites, and the quality-gates step measures whole-tree CRAP against 8.0. If the whole-tree check finds a method over 8.0 that emerged from post-census merges, I'll fix it in this PR.
- New/changed tests were cross-checked statically against the exact helper scaffolds and output strings they assert (`models (provider/model):`, `use /model <n> or`, `no models available` at provider_models.dart:831-834; `_replaceWindowWithChunk` below-count semantics; `parseFrontmatter` trim/newline behavior).

## Threshold-movement ledger (ratchet law)

- core CRAP: 12.0 → 8.0 because the 16 flagged methods above moved (splits + coverage). Only down.
- loc.max_lines: introduced at 2800 (the gh-1232 ceiling, unchanged); baseline entries: none.
- flutter_app CRAP: untouched at 30.0 (not this card's ladder).

## Remaining (none blocking)

- CI green-light on the 8.0 repin (the only unverifiable-locally item, per the disclosure above).
- Follow-up cards per §5 adoption order: `unused_files` gate enabling (excludes documented in-config), `banned_imports` rules, complexity quartet baseline, `public_docs`.

  # flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart, which ci.yml's guard never
  # measures — it scans lib/test/example only) cannot block an unrelated
  # commit. Non-hook runs keep the whole-tree scan below.
  if [ "$HOOK_MODE" -eq 1 ]; then
    local violations
    violations=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM \
      | grep '\.dart$' \
      | grep -vE '\.g\.dart$|\.freezed\.dart$|\.mocks\.dart$|bridge_generated|app_localizations|localizations_' \
      | while IFS= read -r f; do
          [ -f "$f" ] || continue
          lines=$(wc -l < "$f")
          if [ "$lines" -gt "$MAX_LINES" ]; then echo "$f: $lines lines"; fi
        done || true)
    if [ -n "$violations" ]; then
      echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — FILE SIZE (max $MAX_LINES lines)" >&2
      echo "$violations" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    return 0
  fi
  # Same find-exec guard as ci.yml / pre-commit: no dart file over MAX_LINES.
  local dirs=""
  local d
  for d in lib test example bin; do
    [ -d "$d" ] && dirs="$dirs $d"
  done
  if [ "$APP_IN_SCOPE" -eq 1 ] && [ -d flutter_app/lib ]; then
    dirs="$dirs flutter_app/lib"
  fi
  local violations
  violations=$(find $dirs -name '*.dart' \
    ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
    ! -name '*bridge_generated*.dart' ! -name '*app_localizations*.dart' \
    ! -name '*localizations_*.dart' \
    -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt '"$MAX_LINES"' ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
  if [ -n "$violations" ]; then
    echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — FILE SIZE (max $MAX_LINES lines)" >&2
    echo "$violations" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

# Format is SELF-HEALING with a BLOCKING backstop: reformat exactly the
# Dart files in the index and re-stage them; anything still unformatted
# after that (formatter crashed on syntax errors) blocks the commit with a
# clear message. A whole-tree `--set-exit-if-changed` gate both (a) failed
# commits over a single unformatted line and (b) rewrote OTHER agents'
# work-in-progress files mid-edit when run concurrently — scoped auto-fix
# avoids both.
STAGED_DART=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.dart$' || true)
if [ -n "$STAGED_DART" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs dart format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs git add --
  UNFORMATTED=$(dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed $STAGED_DART 2>/dev/null | grep '^Changed' || true)
  if [ -n "$UNFORMATTED" ]; then
    echo "❌ dart format could not fix these files (syntax error?):"
    echo "$UNFORMATTED"
    exit 1

All required context — ticket description, PR diff, CI status, and related materials — has already been prepared in the `input/` folder. Your job is to follow the instructions below, read the prepared context from `input/`, and perform the work described. Do not ask for identifiers; the context is already available locally. ```mermaid flowchart TD G1["⚠️ Review Guidelines — evaluate against existing codebase patterns"] G2["Before reviewing, explore the project's code structure, architecture, and testing patterns"] G3["If AGENTS.md exists → READ it — defines coding styles to check against"] G4["Flag deviations from established patterns unless justified in PR description"] G1 --> G2 --> G3 --> G4 ``` # PR Review General Guidelines ## Review flow ```mermaid flowchart TD START([PR ready for review]) --> READ["1. Read input context:
instruction.md, ticket.md, pr_info.md,

pr_discussions_raw.json"] READ --> DIFF["2. Run diff checklist on pr_diff.txt"] DIFF --> FILES["3. Read full content of every changed file"] FILES --> CODEGRAPH["4. Use CodeGraph:
callers/callees of changed symbols,
search for sensitive patterns,
impact analysis"] CODEGRAPH --> DIMS["5. Evaluate review dimensions:
Security · Architecture/OOP · Code quality
Test coverage · Duplication · Backward compatibility"] DIMS --> SEVERITY["6. Classify each finding:
BLOCKING / IMPORTANT / SUGGESTION"] SEVERITY --> EXHAUST["7. Exhaustive pass:
re-read changed files,
surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. #

sources: [lib, bin]

exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'
  - 'vendor/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in the repo. Descent (issue #1234): the
  # whole-tree offenders went down — readPasteboardImage 16.32 (split into
  # fake-seam / platform-dispatch helpers), the CC-12 trio (_handleTreeKey,
  # discoverTaskAgents, _rebuild) split into cohesive sub-dispatchers, the
  # four 0%-cov CC-3 methods covered by tests (frontmatter, video endpoint,
  # below-window ingest, provider picker), the CC-9 tier split or covered,
  # and _listModels covered by the line-mode /models test (the old NOTE
  # below is history). Threshold follows the fixes: 12.0 → 8.0 — the
  # classic green zone (ratchet history 356 → 65 → 16 → 8 → 12 → 8). Only
  # down from here.
  threshold: 8.0
  # _listModels used to hit 20 with 0% coverage (line-mode-only output);
  # covered by test/cli/provider_models_line_mode_test.dart in #1234.

# ─── loc gate (issue #1234, gh-1232 migration) ─────────────────────────────
# The ≤2800-line file guard MOVED from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size +
# the ci.yml shell find-exec guards onto crap4dart's `loc` gate (0.11.0,
# maintainer-confirmed wc -l semantics). Enforced whole-tree on every merge
# validation via `crap4dart check --baseline` (CI quality-gates step) and
# staged files in the pre-commit hook — no staged-scoping escape, no
# hook-dependence, merge-bot merges included. max_lines only DOWN;
# app_localizations.dart is gen-l10n OUTPUT (no .g.dart suffix) — excluded,
# not baselined.

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right
  # before the CRAP step runs.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is
# enforced here, everything else is disabled explicitly so a bare
# `check --staged` (pre-commit, core-only #433 split) means exactly the
# pixel gate. The flutter_app goldens live in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: the whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was stage_size +
  # ci.yml shell find-exec, gh-1232). wc -l semantics, generated output
  # excluded — nothing exceeds 2800 today, so the shrink-only baseline
  # starts EMPTY of loc entries.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
      - 'vendor/**'
  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet above already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}
  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
  unused_code: {enabled: false}
  unused_files: {enabled: false} # follow-up card (issue #1234 §5). Known
    # FPs to exclude when enabling: the conditional-export IO entry points
    # (lib/io.dart, lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart — public barrels whose
    # importers live outside this repo's import graph) and shared pinned
    # data modules imported only from test/ (lib/src/cli/omp_reg_scenarios.dart,
    # issue #810). lib/fanet.dart was the one confirmed-dead hit — deleted
    # in #1234.
  banned_imports: {enabled: false}
  # Type-2 duplication gate (issue #1106, crap4dart 0.11.0). Renamed-clone
  # detection on top of the Type-1 default; the union with the raw pass can
  # only ADD findings, never lose exact copies. severity: warning starts
  # soft — escalate to error once the 13-file triage debt is paid
  # (follow-up, owner-side). The global jscpd <1% guards stay as-is.
  #
  # Two suppression channels with different contracts:
  # - `// crap:ignore` (needs ignorable: true) = a JUSTIFIED structural
  #   twin, suppressed forever, with a one-line reason in the comment.
  # - `.crap-baseline.json` (via `check --baseline`) = LEGACY debt; the

  #   `dart pub global run crap4dart check --save-baseline` and commit the
  #   only-down diff, or the snapshot rots and starts masking shifts.

  # WINDOW (until severity flips to error): the gate never fails a build —
  # new (not-baselined) duplication only surfaces as a `[WARN]` line in
  # `check` output. Enforcement becomes hard exactly when the owner-side
  # escalation lands; from then on any finding outside the two channels
  # fails CI/pre-commit.

    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    ignorable: true # enables `// crap:ignore` for justified structural twins
    ignore_locals: true # Type-2: rename locals before hashing (API names stay)
    ignore_literals: false # keeps l10n/theme/symbol tables out
    sources: # cross-module scope from #487

      - packages/fa_ui/lib
      - packages/fa_llm/lib
  file_naming: {enabled: false}
  magic_constants: {enabled: false}
  test_assertions: {enabled: false}
  folder_structure: {enabled: false}
  external: {enabled: false}
  public_docs: {enabled: false}
  golden: {enabled: false} # flutter-only gate (core is not a Flutter project)
  accessibility: {enabled: false}
  hardcoded_strings: {enabled: false}

  # Pixel gate over core test/ goldens — none exist today, so this is a
  # no-op that guards the future (issue #447 AC: "and core test/ goldens
  # if any appear"). WARNING, same rationale as flutter_app: the 0.9.5
  # detector misses the Ahem-solid-rect and hollow-square classes and
  # false-positives on V-converging shapes; flip to error when the
  # upstream detector fixes land.
  broken_goldens:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    dirs: [test]
    exclude:
      # TUI screenshots, not goldens: amber/yellow text on the dark theme
      # trips the stripe heuristic (measured 14/14 "overflow stripes" —
      # the same yellow-on-dark detector bug the issue documents for
      # apps_panel/panel_dark). Revisit when upstream fixes land.
      - 'test/integration/**'

stage_size() {
  # Hook mode scopes the guard to the STAGED Dart files: the guard ratchets
  # what a commit touches, so a pre-existing oversized file elsewhere (e.g.
  # flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart, which ci.yml's guard never
  # measures — it scans lib/test/example only) cannot block an unrelated
  # commit. Non-hook runs keep the whole-tree scan below.
  if [ "$HOOK_MODE" -eq 1 ]; then
    local violations
    violations=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM \
      | grep '\.dart$' \
      | grep -vE '\.g\.dart$|\.freezed\.dart$|\.mocks\.dart$|bridge_generated|app_localizations|localizations_' \
      | while IFS= read -r f; do
          [ -f "$f" ] || continue
          lines=$(wc -l < "$f")
          if [ "$lines" -gt "$MAX_LINES" ]; then echo "$f: $lines lines"; fi
        done || true)
    if [ -n "$violations" ]; then
      echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — FILE SIZE (max $MAX_LINES lines)" >&2
      echo "$violations" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    return 0
  fi
  # Same find-exec guard as ci.yml / pre-commit: no dart file over MAX_LINES.
  local dirs=""
  local d
  for d in lib test example bin; do
    [ -d "$d" ] && dirs="$dirs $d"
  done
  if [ "$APP_IN_SCOPE" -eq 1 ] && [ -d flutter_app/lib ]; then
    dirs="$dirs flutter_app/lib"
  fi
  local violations
  violations=$(find $dirs -name '*.dart' \
    ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
    ! -name '*bridge_generated*.dart' ! -name '*app_localizations*.dart' \
    ! -name '*localizations_*.dart' \
    -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt '"$MAX_LINES"' ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
  if [ -n "$violations" ]; then
    echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — FILE SIZE (max $MAX_LINES lines)" >&2
    echo "$violations" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

echo "🎨 Auto-formatting staged Dart files..."
# Format is SELF-HEALING with a BLOCKING backstop: reformat exactly the
# Dart files in the index and re-stage them; anything still unformatted
# after that (formatter crashed on syntax errors) blocks the commit with a
# clear message. A whole-tree `--set-exit-if-changed` gate both (a) failed
# commits over a single unformatted line and (b) rewrote OTHER agents'
# work-in-progress files mid-edit when run concurrently — scoped auto-fix
# avoids both.
STAGED_DART=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.dart$' || true)
if [ -n "$STAGED_DART" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs dart format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs git add --
  UNFORMATTED=$(dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed $STAGED_DART 2>/dev/null | grep '^Changed' || true)
  if [ -n "$UNFORMATTED" ]; then
    echo "❌ dart format could not fix these files (syntax error?):"
    echo "$UNFORMATTED"
    exit 1

    # uses 0.11.0-only keys (ignore_locals/ignorable); the strict config
    # parser throws ConfigException on unknown keys, so older pins fail
    # rather than silently run without Type-2 detection.
    0.1[1-9].*|0.[2-9][0-9].*|[1-9].*)
      echo "🧪 crap4dart gates (staged core files)..."

      # committed snapshot of pre-existing findings; hooks must flag only
      # NEW duplication, same contract as CI.
      if ! dart pub global run crap4dart check --staged --baseline; then
        echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — crap4dart gates" >&2

      fi
      ;;
    "")
      ;; # not activated — skip silently (CI and the fast gate cover it)

           "skipping — run: dart pub global activate crap4dart '>=0.11.0 <0.12.0'" >&2
      ;;
  esac
fi

# Golden-coverage quick check — only when the staged diff can affect the
# flutter_app (the gate's own markers already told us the flutter stage
# ran or was skipped; recompute cheaply from the staged paths here).
STAGED=$(git diff --cached --name-only || true)
if echo "$STAGED" | grep -qE '^(flutter_app/|packages/|lib/|scripts/|\.github/|pubspec\.)' \
   || ! echo "$STAGED" | grep -qE '\.(md)$|^docs/|^prompts/'; then

    echo "🔍 Checking golden coverage..."
    if python3 scripts/check_goldens.py --quick; then
      echo "✅ Golden gate OK"
    else
      exit 1
    fi
  fi

  - '**.freezed.dart'

  enabled: true

# The ≤2800-line file guard MOVED from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size +

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right
  # before the CRAP step runs.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
      - 'vendor/**'

  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet above already covers it

  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
  unused_code: {enabled: false}
  unused_files: {enabled: false} # follow-up card (issue #1234 §5). Known
    # FPs to exclude when enabling: the conditional-export IO entry points

    # importers live outside this repo's import graph) and shared pinned
    # data modules imported only from test/ (lib/src/cli/omp_reg_scenarios.dart,

  public_docs: {enabled: false}

stage_size() {
  # Hook mode scopes the guard to the STAGED Dart files: the guard ratchets
  # what a commit touches, so a pre-existing oversized file elsewhere (e.g.
  # flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart, which ci.yml's guard never
  # measures — it scans lib/test/example only) cannot block an unrelated
  # commit. Non-hook runs keep the whole-tree scan below.
  if [ "$HOOK_MODE" -eq 1 ]; then
    local violations
    violations=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM \
      | grep '\.dart$' \
      | grep -vE '\.g\.dart$|\.freezed\.dart$|\.mocks\.dart$|bridge_generated|app_localizations|localizations_' \
      | while IFS= read -r f; do
          [ -f "$f" ] || continue
          lines=$(wc -l < "$f")
          if [ "$lines" -gt "$MAX_LINES" ]; then echo "$f: $lines lines"; fi
        done || true)
    if [ -n "$violations" ]; then
      echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — FILE SIZE (max $MAX_LINES lines)" >&2
      echo "$violations" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    return 0
  fi
  # Same find-exec guard as ci.yml / pre-commit: no dart file over MAX_LINES.
  local dirs=""
  local d
  for d in lib test example bin; do
    [ -d "$d" ] && dirs="$dirs $d"
  done
  if [ "$APP_IN_SCOPE" -eq 1 ] && [ -d flutter_app/lib ]; then
    dirs="$dirs flutter_app/lib"
  fi
  local violations
  violations=$(find $dirs -name '*.dart' \
    ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
    ! -name '*bridge_generated*.dart' ! -name '*app_localizations*.dart' \
    ! -name '*localizations_*.dart' \
    -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt '"$MAX_LINES"' ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
  if [ -n "$violations" ]; then
    echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — FILE SIZE (max $MAX_LINES lines)" >&2
    echo "$violations" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  C4D_VER=$(dart pub global list 2>/dev/null | awk '$1=="crap4dart"{print $2}')
  case "$C4D_VER" in

# crap4dart configuration for flutter_agent_harness.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart
#
# RATCHET: the CRAP threshold is pinned at the current worst score
# (356.34, `_handleKey` in bin/../tui_repl.dart) — pushes may only make
# the codebase BETTER, never worse. Lower the threshold whenever the top
# offenders are fixed (run: dart pub global run crap4dart analyze).

sources: [lib, bin]

exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'
  - 'vendor/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in the repo. Descent (issue #1234): the
  # whole-tree offenders went down — readPasteboardImage 16.32 (split into
  # fake-seam / platform-dispatch helpers), the CC-12 trio (_handleTreeKey,
  # discoverTaskAgents, _rebuild) split into cohesive sub-dispatchers, the
  # four 0%-cov CC-3 methods covered by tests (frontmatter, video endpoint,
  # below-window ingest, provider picker), the CC-9 tier split or covered,
  # and _listModels covered by the line-mode /models test (the old NOTE
  # below is history). Threshold follows the fixes: 12.0 → 8.0 — the
  # classic green zone (ratchet history 356 → 65 → 16 → 8 → 12 → 8). Only
  # down from here.
  threshold: 8.0
  # _listModels used to hit 20 with 0% coverage (line-mode-only output);
  # covered by test/cli/provider_models_line_mode_test.dart in #1234.

# ─── loc gate (issue #1234, gh-1232 migration) ─────────────────────────────
# The ≤2800-line file guard MOVED from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size +
# the ci.yml shell find-exec guards onto crap4dart's `loc` gate (0.11.0,
# maintainer-confirmed wc -l semantics). Enforced whole-tree on every merge
# validation via `crap4dart check --baseline` (CI quality-gates step) and
# staged files in the pre-commit hook — no staged-scoping escape, no
# hook-dependence, merge-bot merges included. max_lines only DOWN;
# app_localizations.dart is gen-l10n OUTPUT (no .g.dart suffix) — excluded,
# not baselined.

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right
  # before the CRAP step runs.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is
# enforced here, everything else is disabled explicitly so a bare
# `check --staged` (pre-commit, core-only #433 split) means exactly the
# pixel gate. The flutter_app goldens live in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: the whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was stage_size +
  # ci.yml shell find-exec, gh-1232). wc -l semantics, generated output
  # excluded — nothing exceeds 2800 today, so the shrink-only baseline
  # starts EMPTY of loc entries.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
      - 'vendor/**'
  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet above already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}
  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
  unused_code: {enabled: false}
  unused_files: {enabled: false} # follow-up card (issue #1234 §5). Known
    # FPs to exclude when enabling: the conditional-export IO entry points
    # (lib/io.dart, lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart — public barrels whose
    # importers live outside this repo's import graph) and shared pinned
    # data modules imported only from test/ (lib/src/cli/omp_reg_scenarios.dart,
    # issue #810). lib/fanet.dart was the one confirmed-dead hit — deleted
    # in #1234.
  banned_imports: {enabled: false}
  # Type-2 duplication gate (issue #1106, crap4dart 0.11.0). Renamed-clone
  # detection on top of the Type-1 default; the union with the raw pass can
  # only ADD findings, never lose exact copies. severity: warning starts
  # soft — escalate to error once the 13-file triage debt is paid
  # (follow-up, owner-side). The global jscpd <1% guards stay as-is.

stage_size() {
  # Hook mode scopes the guard to the STAGED Dart files: the guard ratchets
  # what a commit touches, so a pre-existing oversized file elsewhere (e.g.
  # flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart, which ci.yml's guard never
  # measures — it scans lib/test/example only) cannot block an unrelated
  # commit. Non-hook runs keep the whole-tree scan below.
  if [ "$HOOK_MODE" -eq 1 ]; then
    local violations
    violations=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM \
      | grep '\.dart$' \
      | grep -vE '\.g\.dart$|\.freezed\.dart$|\.mocks\.dart$|bridge_generated|app_localizations|localizations_' \
      | while IFS= read -r f; do
          [ -f "$f" ] || continue
          lines=$(wc -l < "$f")
          if [ "$lines" -gt "$MAX_LINES" ]; then echo "$f: $lines lines"; fi
        done || true)
    if [ -n "$violations" ]; then
      echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — FILE SIZE (max $MAX_LINES lines)" >&2
      echo "$violations" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    return 0
  fi
  # Same find-exec guard as ci.yml / pre-commit: no dart file over MAX_LINES.
  local dirs=""
  local d
  for d in lib test example bin; do
    [ -d "$d" ] && dirs="$dirs $d"
  done
  if [ "$APP_IN_SCOPE" -eq 1 ] && [ -d flutter_app/lib ]; then
    dirs="$dirs flutter_app/lib"
  fi
  local violations
  violations=$(find $dirs -name '*.dart' \
    ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
    ! -name '*bridge_generated*.dart' ! -name '*app_localizations*.dart' \
    ! -name '*localizations_*.dart' \
    -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt '"$MAX_LINES"' ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
  if [ -n "$violations" ]; then
    echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — FILE SIZE (max $MAX_LINES lines)" >&2
    echo "$violations" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

# 0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is

      - '**.mocks.dart'

  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet above already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}
  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
  unused_code: {enabled: false}
  unused_files: {enabled: false} # follow-up card (issue #1234 §5). Known
    # FPs to exclude when enabling: the conditional-export IO entry points
    # (lib/io.dart, lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart — public barrels whose
    # importers live outside this repo's import graph) and shared pinned
    # data modules imported only from test/ (lib/src/cli/omp_reg_scenarios.dart,
    # issue #810). lib/fanet.dart was the one confirmed-dead hit — deleted
    # in #1234.
  banned_imports: {enabled: false}
  # Type-2 duplication gate (issue #1106, crap4dart 0.11.0). Renamed-clone
  # detection on top of the Type-1 default; the union with the raw pass can
  # only ADD findings, never lose exact copies. severity: warning starts
  # soft — escalate to error once the 13-file triage debt is paid
  # (follow-up, owner-side). The global jscpd <1% guards stay as-is.
  #
  # Two suppression channels with different contracts:
  # - `// crap:ignore` (needs ignorable: true) = a JUSTIFIED structural
  #   twin, suppressed forever, with a one-line reason in the comment.
  # - `.crap-baseline.json` (via `check --baseline`) = LEGACY debt; the

  #   `dart pub global run crap4dart check --save-baseline` and commit the

  # WINDOW (until severity flips to error): the gate never fails a build —

  # escalation lands; from then on any finding outside the two channels

    severity: warning
    ignorable: true # enables `// crap:ignore` for justified structural twins
    ignore_locals: true # Type-2: rename locals before hashing (API names stay)
    ignore_literals: false # keeps l10n/theme/symbol tables out

      - packages/fa_ui/lib

  file_naming: {enabled: false}
  magic_constants: {enabled: false}
  test_assertions: {enabled: false}
  folder_structure: {enabled: false}
  external: {enabled: false}
  public_docs: {enabled: false}

  accessibility: {enabled: false}
  hardcoded_strings: {enabled: false}

  # upstream detector fixes land.

    exclude:

      # trips the stripe heuristic (measured 14/14 "overflow stripes" —
      # the same yellow-on-dark detector bug the issue documents for
      # apps_panel/panel_dark). Revisit when upstream fixes land.
      - 'test/integration/**'

stage_size() {
  # Hook mode scopes the guard to the STAGED Dart files: the guard ratchets
  # what a commit touches, so a pre-existing oversized file elsewhere (e.g.
  # flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart, which ci.yml's guard never
  # measures — it scans lib/test/example only) cannot block an unrelated
  # commit. Non-hook runs keep the whole-tree scan below.
  if [ "$HOOK_MODE" -eq 1 ]; then
    local violations
    violations=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM \
      | grep '\.dart$' \
      | grep -vE '\.g\.dart$|\.freezed\.dart$|\.mocks\.dart$|bridge_generated|app_localizations|localizations_' \
      | while IFS= read -r f; do
          [ -f "$f" ] || continue
          lines=$(wc -l < "$f")
          if [ "$lines" -gt "$MAX_LINES" ]; then echo "$f: $lines lines"; fi
        done || true)
    if [ -n "$violations" ]; then
      echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — FILE SIZE (max $MAX_LINES lines)" >&2
      echo "$violations" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    return 0
  fi
  # Same find-exec guard as ci.yml / pre-commit: no dart file over MAX_LINES.
  local dirs=""
  local d
  for d in lib test example bin; do
    [ -d "$d" ] && dirs="$dirs $d"
  done
  if [ "$APP_IN_SCOPE" -eq 1 ] && [ -d flutter_app/lib ]; then
    dirs="$dirs flutter_app/lib"
  fi
  local violations
  violations=$(find $dirs -name '*.dart' \
    ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
    ! -name '*bridge_generated*.dart' ! -name '*app_localizations*.dart' \
    ! -name '*localizations_*.dart' \
    -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt '"$MAX_LINES"' ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
  if [ -n "$violations" ]; then
    echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — FILE SIZE (max $MAX_LINES lines)" >&2
    echo "$violations" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs dart format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs git add --

if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  C4D_VER=$(dart pub global list 2>/dev/null | awk '$1=="crap4dart"{print $2}')
  case "$C4D_VER" in

      echo "🧪 crap4dart gates (staged core files)..."

      if ! dart pub global run crap4dart check --staged --baseline; then

- CC-12 trio split into cohesive sub-dispatchers: `_treeMoveKey`/`_treeCollapseKey` (agent_hub_tui.dart), `_scanAgentRoot`/`_ingestAgentEntry` (task/agent_discovery.dart), `_rewriteAssistantCallIds`/`_emitSlotResults` (agent/tool_pairing.dart)

**AC5 — unused_files triage**: `lib/fanet.dart` deleted — zero references anywhere (not in the main barrel, no imports, no docs/scripts). `omp_reg_scenarios.dart` kept — NOT dead: live test importer (test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart) and the #810 pinned-shared-data docstring says it must stay. The conditional-export IO FP class (lib/io.dart style entry points) is documented with exclude guidance at the `unused_files` config line for the follow-up card. Gate enabling stays a follow-up per the issue's §5 adoption order ("this card = loc + whole-tree CRAP + §3 fixes").

## Verification (honest disclosure)

- `scripts/check_crap_guards.py` — green locally: badge==config parity (8.0/30.0), generated-exclude parity, `--only-down origin/main` pass.
- YAML validity of both configs + ci.yml asserted; `bash -n` on the touched shell scripts.
- **The dart toolchain on this box is SIGKILLed by the machine guard (exit 137 on `dart --version`)** — the targeted `dart analyze` + new test files could NOT be run locally. CI is the real gate: the static job compiles/analyzes, test shards run the 3 new/extended suites, and the quality-gates step measures whole-tree CRAP against 8.0. If the whole-tree check finds a method over 8.0 that emerged from post-census merges, I'll fix it in this PR.
- New/changed tests were cross-checked statically against the exact helper scaffolds and output strings they assert (`models (provider/model):`, `use /model <n> or`, `no models available` at provider_models.dart:831-834; `_replaceWindowWithChunk` below-count semantics; `parseFrontmatter` trim/newline behavior).

## Threshold-movement ledger (ratchet law)

- core CRAP: 12.0 → 8.0 because the 16 flagged methods above moved (splits + coverage). Only down.
- loc.max_lines: introduced at 2800 (the gh-1232 ceiling, unchanged); baseline entries: none.
- flutter_app CRAP: untouched at 30.0 (not this card's ladder).

## Remaining (none blocking)

- CI green-light on the 8.0 repin (the only unverifiable-locally item, per the disclosure above).
- Follow-up cards per §5 adoption order: `unused_files` gate enabling (excludes documented in-config), `banned_imports` rules, complexity quartet baseline, `public_docs`.

  # flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart, which ci.yml's guard never
  # measures — it scans lib/test/example only) cannot block an unrelated
  # commit. Non-hook runs keep the whole-tree scan below.
  if [ "$HOOK_MODE" -eq 1 ]; then
    local violations
    violations=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM \
      | grep '\.dart$' \
      | grep -vE '\.g\.dart$|\.freezed\.dart$|\.mocks\.dart$|bridge_generated|app_localizations|localizations_' \
      | while IFS= read -r f; do
          [ -f "$f" ] || continue
          lines=$(wc -l < "$f")
          if [ "$lines" -gt "$MAX_LINES" ]; then echo "$f: $lines lines"; fi
        done || true)
    if [ -n "$violations" ]; then
      echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — FILE SIZE (max $MAX_LINES lines)" >&2
      echo "$violations" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    return 0
  fi
  # Same find-exec guard as ci.yml / pre-commit: no dart file over MAX_LINES.
  local dirs=""
  local d
  for d in lib test example bin; do
    [ -d "$d" ] && dirs="$dirs $d"
  done

    ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
    ! -name '*bridge_generated*.dart' ! -name '*app_localizations*.dart' \
    ! -name '*localizations_*.dart' \
    -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt '"$MAX_LINES"' ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)

    echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — FILE SIZE (max $MAX_LINES lines)" >&2
    echo "$violations" >&2
    exit 1
  fi

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: loc gate no longer measures `test/` or `example/` — and AGENTS.md overstates the coverage**

The retired guards (`scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size` + both ci.yml find-exec jobs) scanned `lib test example bin` (plus `flutter_app/lib`). The new loc gate inherits the config's `sources: [lib, bin]`, so Dart files under `test/` and `example/` are now measured by **no** loc gate at all — while this PR's updated AGENTS.md claims the ceiling covers "lib bin test example flutter_app/lib". That claim is currently false.

This is not theoretical: three test files already sit within ~50 lines of the cap measured today — `test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart` (2798), `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart` (2756), `test/providers/transient_retry_stream_test.dart` (2754). The next growth of any of them crosses 2800 with zero enforcement, silently violating the documented god-file ceiling.

Options:
- Add a `sources` override to this loc block (same mechanism the `duplication` gate uses below) covering `test` and `example`, or
- If the narrowed scope is intentional per the issue's maintainer recipe, fix the AGENTS.md/GOAL.md wording to say `lib bin flutter_app/lib` explicitly and note the test/example carve-out.

Either way the doc and the config should agree before merge.

💡 **SUGGESTION: duplicated assignment and section header**

The `stage_size` deletion left a leftover duplicate:

```bash
FLUTTER_ANALYZED=0

# ── Stage implementations ────
FLUTTER_ANALYZED=0

# ── Stage implementations ────
stage_analyze() {
```

Lines 202–203 (the first `FLUTTER_ANALYZED=0` + header) and 205–207 are now redundant — the merge of the removal hunk re-added both. Harmless at runtime, but the double "Stage implementations" header will confuse the next editor. Drop the second `FLUTTER_ANALYZED=0` and one header.

💡 **SUGGESTION: gen-l10n locale variants are not excluded**

The retired shell guard excluded `*localizations_*.dart`, which covered all three gen-l10n outputs. This gate excludes only `lib/l10n/app_localizations.dart`; the locale variants `app_localizations_en.dart` (2553 lines) and `app_localizations_ru.dart` (2581 lines) are also generated output and currently pass only because they are under 2800. The first l10n growth that pushes a locale file past the cap will fail CI on a file no human edits.

Either add the two locale files (or a `'lib/l10n/**'` pattern) to this exclude list, or add a comment noting they are deliberately gated.

# crap4dart configuration for flutter_agent_harness.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart
#
# RATCHET: the CRAP threshold is pinned at the current worst score
# (356.34, `_handleKey` in bin/../tui_repl.dart) — pushes may only make
# the codebase BETTER, never worse. Lower the threshold whenever the top
# offenders are fixed (run: dart pub global run crap4dart analyze).

sources: [lib, bin]

exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'
  - 'vendor/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in the repo. Descent (issue #1234): the
  # whole-tree offenders went down — readPasteboardImage 16.32 (split into
  # fake-seam / platform-dispatch helpers), the CC-12 trio (_handleTreeKey,
  # discoverTaskAgents, _rebuild) split into cohesive sub-dispatchers, the
  # four 0%-cov CC-3 methods covered by tests (frontmatter, video endpoint,
  # below-window ingest, provider picker), the CC-9 tier split or covered,
  # and _listModels covered by the line-mode /models test (the old NOTE
  # below is history). Threshold follows the fixes: 12.0 → 8.0 — the
  # classic green zone (ratchet history 356 → 65 → 16 → 8 → 12 → 8). Only
  # down from here.
  threshold: 8.0
  # _listModels used to hit 20 with 0% coverage (line-mode-only output);
  # covered by test/cli/provider_models_line_mode_test.dart in #1234.

# ─── loc gate (issue #1234, gh-1232 migration) ─────────────────────────────
# The ≤2800-line file guard MOVED from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size +
# the ci.yml shell find-exec guards onto crap4dart's `loc` gate (0.11.0,
# maintainer-confirmed wc -l semantics). Enforced whole-tree on every merge
# validation via `crap4dart check --baseline` (CI quality-gates step) and
# staged files in the pre-commit hook — no staged-scoping escape, no
# hook-dependence, merge-bot merges included. max_lines only DOWN;
# app_localizations.dart is gen-l10n OUTPUT (no .g.dart suffix) — excluded,
# not baselined.

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right
  # before the CRAP step runs.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is
# enforced here, everything else is disabled explicitly so a bare
# `check --staged` (pre-commit, core-only #433 split) means exactly the
# pixel gate. The flutter_app goldens live in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: the whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was stage_size +
  # ci.yml shell find-exec, gh-1232). wc -l semantics, generated output
  # excluded — nothing exceeds 2800 today, so the shrink-only baseline
  # starts EMPTY of loc entries.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
      - 'vendor/**'
  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet above already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}
  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
