stage_size() {
  # Hook mode scopes the guard to the STAGED Dart files: the guard ratchets
  # what a commit touches, so a pre-existing oversized file elsewhere (e.g.
  # flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart, which ci.yml's guard never
  # measures — it scans lib/test/example only) cannot block an unrelated
  # commit. Non-hook runs keep the whole-tree scan below.
  if [ "$HOOK_MODE" -eq 1 ]; then
    local violations
    violations=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM \
      | grep '\.dart$' \
      | grep -vE '\.g\.dart$|\.freezed\.dart$|\.mocks\.dart$|bridge_generated|app_localizations|localizations_' \
      | while IFS= read -r f; do
          [ -f "$f" ] || continue
          lines=$(wc -l < "$f")
          if [ "$lines" -gt "$MAX_LINES" ]; then echo "$f: $lines lines"; fi
        done || true)
    if [ -n "$violations" ]; then
      echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — FILE SIZE (max $MAX_LINES lines)" >&2
      echo "$violations" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    return 0
  fi
  # Same find-exec guard as ci.yml / pre-commit: no dart file over MAX_LINES.
  local dirs=""
  local d
  for d in lib test example bin; do
    [ -d "$d" ] && dirs="$dirs $d"
  done
  if [ "$APP_IN_SCOPE" -eq 1 ] && [ -d flutter_app/lib ]; then
    dirs="$dirs flutter_app/lib"
  fi
  local violations
  violations=$(find $dirs -name '*.dart' \
    ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
    ! -name '*bridge_generated*.dart' ! -name '*app_localizations*.dart' \
    ! -name '*localizations_*.dart' \
    -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt '"$MAX_LINES"' ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
  if [ -n "$violations" ]; then
    echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — FILE SIZE (max $MAX_LINES lines)" >&2
    echo "$violations" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right

  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is
# enforced here, everything else is disabled explicitly so a bare
# `check --staged` (pre-commit, core-only #433 split) means exactly the

gates:
  # Issue #1234: the whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was stage_size +
  # ci.yml shell find-exec, gh-1232). wc -l semantics, generated output
  # excluded — nothing exceeds 2800 today, so the shrink-only baseline
  # starts EMPTY of loc entries.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
      - 'vendor/**'
  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet above already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}
  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
  unused_code: {enabled: false}
  unused_files: {enabled: false} # follow-up card (issue #1234 §5). Known
    # FPs to exclude when enabling: the conditional-export IO entry points
    # (lib/io.dart, lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart — public barrels whose
    # importers live outside this repo's import graph) and shared pinned
    # data modules imported only from test/ (lib/src/cli/omp_reg_scenarios.dart,
    # issue #810). lib/fanet.dart was the one confirmed-dead hit — deleted
    # in #1234.
  banned_imports: {enabled: false}
  # Type-2 duplication gate (issue #1106, crap4dart 0.11.0). Renamed-clone
  # detection on top of the Type-1 default; the union with the raw pass can
  # only ADD findings, never lose exact copies. severity: warning starts
  # soft — escalate to error once the 13-file triage debt is paid
  # (follow-up, owner-side). The global jscpd <1% guards stay as-is.
  #
  # Two suppression channels with different contracts:
  # - `// crap:ignore` (needs ignorable: true) = a JUSTIFIED structural
  #   twin, suppressed forever, with a one-line reason in the comment.
  # - `.crap-baseline.json` (via `check --baseline`) = LEGACY debt; the
  #   committed snapshot must only SHRINK: after each triage batch re-run
  #   `dart pub global run crap4dart check --save-baseline` and commit the
  #   only-down diff, or the snapshot rots and starts masking shifts.
  #
  # WINDOW (until severity flips to error): the gate never fails a build —
  # new (not-baselined) duplication only surfaces as a `[WARN]` line in
  # `check` output. Enforcement becomes hard exactly when the owner-side
  # escalation lands; from then on any finding outside the two channels
  # fails CI/pre-commit.
  duplication:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    ignorable: true # enables `// crap:ignore` for justified structural twins
    ignore_locals: true # Type-2: rename locals before hashing (API names stay)
    ignore_literals: false # keeps l10n/theme/symbol tables out
    sources: # cross-module scope from #487
      - flutter_app/lib
      - packages/fa_ui/lib
      - packages/fa_llm/lib
  file_naming: {enabled: false}
  magic_constants: {enabled: false}
  test_assertions: {enabled: false}
  folder_structure: {enabled: false}
  external: {enabled: false}
  public_docs: {enabled: false}
  golden: {enabled: false} # flutter-only gate (core is not a Flutter project)
  accessibility: {enabled: false}
  hardcoded_strings: {enabled: false}

  # Pixel gate over core test/ goldens — none exist today, so this is a
  # no-op that guards the future (issue #447 AC: "and core test/ goldens
  # if any appear"). WARNING, same rationale as flutter_app: the 0.9.5
  # detector misses the Ahem-solid-rect and hollow-square classes and

  # upstream detector fixes land.

    severity: warning
    dirs: [test]
    exclude:

      # trips the stripe heuristic (measured 14/14 "overflow stripes" —
      # the same yellow-on-dark detector bug the issue documents for
      # apps_panel/panel_dark). Revisit when upstream fixes land.
      - 'test/integration/**'

stage_size() {
  # Hook mode scopes the guard to the STAGED Dart files: the guard ratchets
  # what a commit touches, so a pre-existing oversized file elsewhere (e.g.
  # flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart, which ci.yml's guard never
  # measures — it scans lib/test/example only) cannot block an unrelated
  # commit. Non-hook runs keep the whole-tree scan below.
  if [ "$HOOK_MODE" -eq 1 ]; then
    local violations
    violations=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM \
      | grep '\.dart$' \
      | grep -vE '\.g\.dart$|\.freezed\.dart$|\.mocks\.dart$|bridge_generated|app_localizations|localizations_' \
      | while IFS= read -r f; do
          [ -f "$f" ] || continue
          lines=$(wc -l < "$f")
          if [ "$lines" -gt "$MAX_LINES" ]; then echo "$f: $lines lines"; fi
        done || true)
    if [ -n "$violations" ]; then
      echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — FILE SIZE (max $MAX_LINES lines)" >&2
      echo "$violations" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    return 0
  fi
  # Same find-exec guard as ci.yml / pre-commit: no dart file over MAX_LINES.
  local dirs=""
  local d
  for d in lib test example bin; do
    [ -d "$d" ] && dirs="$dirs $d"
  done
  if [ "$APP_IN_SCOPE" -eq 1 ] && [ -d flutter_app/lib ]; then
    dirs="$dirs flutter_app/lib"
  fi
  local violations
  violations=$(find $dirs -name '*.dart' \
    ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
    ! -name '*bridge_generated*.dart' ! -name '*app_localizations*.dart' \
    ! -name '*localizations_*.dart' \
    -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt '"$MAX_LINES"' ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
  if [ -n "$violations" ]; then
    echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — FILE SIZE (max $MAX_LINES lines)" >&2
    echo "$violations" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

echo "🎨 Auto-formatting staged Dart files..."
# Format is SELF-HEALING with a BLOCKING backstop: reformat exactly the
# Dart files in the index and re-stage them; anything still unformatted
# after that (formatter crashed on syntax errors) blocks the commit with a
# clear message. A whole-tree `--set-exit-if-changed` gate both (a) failed

# work-in-progress files mid-edit when run concurrently — scoped auto-fix
# avoids both.
STAGED_DART=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.dart$' || true)
if [ -n "$STAGED_DART" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs dart format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs git add --
  UNFORMATTED=$(dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed $STAGED_DART 2>/dev/null | grep '^Changed' || true)
  if [ -n "$UNFORMATTED" ]; then
    echo "❌ dart format could not fix these files (syntax error?):"
    echo "$UNFORMATTED"
    exit 1

# Issue #447: crap4dart quality gates over the STAGED core diff
# (core-only #433 split — the flutter_app gates run in CI's
# app-crap-gate job). The root crap4dart.yaml enables exactly
# broken_goldens; `check --staged` no-ops when no Dart file is staged.
# Equivalent to the managed block `crap4dart install --force` would
# append — do not stack both. Requires crap4dart >= 0.9 (the gate
# framework; older pins only knew `analyze`).
if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  C4D_VER=$(dart pub global list 2>/dev/null | awk '$1=="crap4dart"{print $2}')
  case "$C4D_VER" in
    # gh-1106: floor 0.11.0 — the root crap4dart.yaml duplication block
    # uses 0.11.0-only keys (ignore_locals/ignorable); the strict config
    # parser throws ConfigException on unknown keys, so older pins fail
    # rather than silently run without Type-2 detection.
    0.1[1-9].*|0.[2-9][0-9].*|[1-9].*)
      echo "🧪 crap4dart gates (staged core files)..."
      # gh-1106: --baseline — the Type-2 duplication gate ships with a
      # committed snapshot of pre-existing findings; hooks must flag only
      # NEW duplication, same contract as CI.
      if ! dart pub global run crap4dart check --staged --baseline; then
        echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — crap4dart gates" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      ;;
    "")
      ;; # not activated — skip silently (CI and the fast gate cover it)
    *)
      echo "⚠️  crap4dart $C4D_VER is too old for the gates (need >= 0.11.0);" \
           "skipping — run: dart pub global activate crap4dart '>=0.11.0 <0.12.0'" >&2
      ;;
  esac
fi

# Golden-coverage quick check — only when the staged diff can affect the
# flutter_app (the gate's own markers already told us the flutter stage
# ran or was skipped; recompute cheaply from the staged paths here).
STAGED=$(git diff --cached --name-only || true)
if echo "$STAGED" | grep -qE '^(flutter_app/|packages/|lib/|scripts/|\.github/|pubspec\.)' \
   || ! echo "$STAGED" | grep -qE '\.(md)$|^docs/|^prompts/'; then

    echo "🔍 Checking golden coverage..."
    if python3 scripts/check_goldens.py --quick; then
      echo "✅ Golden gate OK"
    else
      exit 1
    fi

## PR Description

Fixes #1234

## Delivered (AC by AC)

**AC1 — §3 table empty, threshold repinned 12.0 → 8.0** (`crap4dart.yaml`). Threshold moved because the code moved — every census method fixed in this PR:

- `readPasteboardImage` 16.32 → split: `_readFakePasteboard` / `_effectivePlatform` / `_readPlatform` (cli/clipboard_reader.dart)
- CC-12 trio split into cohesive sub-dispatchers: `_treeMoveKey`/`_treeCollapseKey` (agent_hub_tui.dart), `_scanAgentRoot`/`_ingestAgentEntry` (task/agent_discovery.dart), `_rewriteAssistantCallIds`/`_emitSlotResults` (agent/tool_pairing.dart)
- CC-9 tier split: `_kimiImplicitKeyPath`, `_readPassphraseStdin`/`_readPassphrasePrompt`, `_readTtsrSource`/`_validateTtsrEdit`, `_dialInlineImage`/`_dialDownloadUrl`, `_decodeManifestJson`, `_readToolIsSqlite`, `_runVideoGeneration`/`_videoEndpointOrThrow`, `parseStatusLineConfig` helpers
- 0%-cov CC-3 quartet covered by new tests: `parseFrontmatter` (test/utils/frontmatter_parser_test.dart), `resolveVideoGenerationEndpoint` (test/tools/generate_video_test.dart group), `WindowedSessionStorage._ingestBelowWindow` (deep-paged ingest test), `AgentCli._tuiPickProvider` (picker routing test)
- `_listModels` (CRAP 20 @ 0%): covered by test/cli/provider_models_line_mode_test.dart — the line-mode `/models` output path (header/numbered rows/switch hint, unknown-filter branch), via a new `tuiPickProviderForTest` seam alongside the existing ForTest convention. The old "do not ratchet up for it" NOTE is resolved, not exempted.

**AC2 — loc gate + baseline in CI**: `loc: {enabled: true, max_lines: 2800}` in BOTH crap4dart.yaml files (maintainer recipe from the issue comments). Generated excludes per recipe; `flutter_app/lib/l10n/app_localizations.dart` (gen-l10n output, no `.g.dart` suffix) is gate-excluded, not baselined — per the issue's disposition column. **All four census files sit under 2800 on this branch** (gh-1232 splits landed: fah.dart 225, agent_service.dart 2399, wasm_shell.dart 2740), so the committed `.crap-baseline.json` needs ZERO loc entries — shrink-only baseline intact, nothing to pin. Enforcement: `crap4dart check --baseline` (already wired by gh-1232) now runs the loc gate whole-tree on every merge validation, core and app pipelines both.

**AC3 — whole-tree CRAP in CI**: the same `crap4dart check --baseline` steps run the crap gate against the pinned 8.0 on every merge validation (not staged-scoped, merge-bot included). A method pushed over threshold in an untouched file goes red here — that was the latent-red escape the issue documents.

**AC4 — shell guards removed**: `stage_size` + `MAX_LINES` deleted from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh (stage lists, scope maps, runner case, banner); both ci.yml find-exec guards deleted with migration notes. GOAL.md quality-gates section now names the real enforcement points (crap4dart loc + whole-tree CRAP in CI). AGENTS.md CRAP section updated (core 8.0, app 30.0 as measured, 0.11 pin); README badge → 8.0; pre-commit banner updated.

**AC5 — unused_files triage**: `lib/fanet.dart` deleted — zero references anywhere (not in the main barrel, no imports, no docs/scripts). `omp_reg_scenarios.dart` kept — NOT dead: live test importer (test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart) and the #810 pinned-shared-data docstring says it must stay. The conditional-export IO FP class (lib/io.dart style entry points) is documented with exclude guidance at the `unused_files` config line for the follow-up card. Gate enabling stays a follow-up per the issue's §5 adoption order ("this card = loc + whole-tree CRAP + §3 fixes").

## Verification (honest disclosure)

- `scripts/check_crap_guards.py` — green locally: badge==config parity (8.0/30.0), generated-exclude parity, `--only-down origin/main` pass.
- YAML validity of both configs + ci.yml asserted; `bash -n` on the touched shell scripts.
- **The dart toolchain on this box is SIGKILLed by the machine guard (exit 137 on `dart --version`)** — the targeted `dart analyze` + new test files could NOT be run locally. CI is the real gate: the static job compiles/analyzes, test shards run the 3 new/extended suites, and the quality-gates step measures whole-tree CRAP against 8.0. If the whole-tree check finds a method over 8.0 that emerged from post-census merges, I'll fix it in this PR.
- New/changed tests were cross-checked statically against the exact helper scaffolds and output strings they assert (`models (provider/model):`, `use /model <n> or`, `no models available` at provider_models.dart:831-834; `_replaceWindowWithChunk` below-count semantics; `parseFrontmatter` trim/newline behavior).

## Threshold-movement ledger (ratchet law)

- core CRAP: 12.0 → 8.0 because the 16 flagged methods above moved (splits + coverage). Only down.
- loc.max_lines: introduced at 2800 (the gh-1232 ceiling, unchanged); baseline entries: none.
- flutter_app CRAP: untouched at 30.0 (not this card's ladder).

## Remaining (none blocking)

- CI green-light on the 8.0 repin (the only unverifiable-locally item, per the disclosure above).
- Follow-up cards per §5 adoption order: `unused_files` gate enabling (excludes documented in-config), `banned_imports` rules, complexity quartet baseline, `public_docs`.
